asset_heavy.reason: Makes wearable CGM sensors and software; manufacturing is needed but not plants, fleets or networks at utility scale.

big_ticket.reason: Sensors are small, frequent, replaceable purchases every 10-15 days, not large infrequent sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Glucose monitors are medical necessities for diabetes management; patients unlikely to postpone them in a recession.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual patients, plus pharmacies and distributors; insurers pay but customers are mainly households.

notes: Buyers are mainly patients, with distributors and pharmacies reselling; insurers reimburse.

offers_products.reason: Sells Dexcom G7 and G7 15 Day CGM systems and Stelo glucose biosensors with apps.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from sensors, receivers and apps; no separate main service offering is described.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for medical device sensors and software technology, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Disposable CGM sensors are replaced every 10-15 days, so users reorder continuously.

sells_to_consumers.reason: People with diabetes use G7, and Stelo is sold over the counter online to consumers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Distributors and pharmacies buy for resale; there are also healthcare professional and procurement portals.
